summary: Rabbi Akiva learns from a pasuk that an idol makes a person tamei when he carries it, even without touching it, like a niddah.

chunks.en: makes things tamei by carrying, like a niddah?
chunks.st: transmits impurity imparted by carrying even when the person who carries it does not come into contact with it, just as a menstruating woman does?

chunks.en: As it says: "You will throw them away like something tamei;
chunks.st: As it is stated: “And you will defile the silver overlays of your statues, and the golden plating of your idols, you will cast them away as you would a menstruating woman [dava],

chunks.en: Just as a niddah makes things tamei by carrying,
chunks.st: Just as a menstruating woman transmits impurity imparted by carrying,

chunks.en: so too avodah zarah makes things tamei by carrying.
chunks.st: so too, idolatry transmits impurity imparted by carrying.
